visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with styled black hair and a black T-shirt stands in a brightly lit shopping mall holding a microphone, introducing a cosmetics counter. (2) Close-up shot of the man's face as he touches his skin, showing a soft smile. (3) The scene cuts to a well-lit Kanebo department store counter showcasing various cosmetics. (4) The man holds a small black jar of cream and speaks animatedly with a female staff member behind the counter. (5) Close-up of the jar labeled 'KANEBO,' then showing the peach-colored cream inside. (6) The staff member uses a spatula to apply cream to the man's hand, which he then spreads. (7) A side-by-side comparison of his hands shows one is noticeably brighter. (8) The man introduces a black tube of facial cleanser; a dollop of thick white foam is shown on his hand. (9) The man and staff member hold the tube together, smiling and giving thumbs up. (10) A black box of 4-layer cotton pads is shown, then demonstrated by peeling the layers apart and applying them to an arm as a wet pack. (11) The man waves goodbye in front of the counter as the screen fades.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main male creator, 1 female counter staff member.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A male influencer with short black hair, wearing a simple black V-neck T-shirt and black trousers, holding a Rode microphone.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The interior of a high-end department store featuring clean white counters, glass shelving, promotional posters for beauty products, and various Kanebo-branded displays.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat electronic pop BGM kicks in with a clear 4/4 beat. A male voice introduces the video with high energy and professional clarity, set against low-level department store ambiance. (2) Vocal inflection rises as he asks the staff about the product. A 'ding' SFX sounds during the close-up of the foundation jar. (3) The female staff member responds with a soft, friendly tone, explaining product features. The BGM remains steady in the background. (4) A 'pop' SFX accompanies the reveal of the cleanser foam. The male voice exhibits high arousal, expressing surprise at the texture. (5) The pace accelerates with rhythmic hard cuts between descriptions of the three products. Transition 'whoosh' sounds are used occasionally. (6) The video concludes with the male voice waving and saying goodbye, followed by a quick fade-out of the BGM.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Feature Presentation (Product 1) -> Feature Presentation (Product 2) -> Feature Presentation (Product 3) -> Outro/CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote Kanebo cosmetic and skincare products by demonstrating their effectiveness and unique textures in a professional yet accessible shopping mall environment. The creator uses his influence to validate the quality of the foundation, cleanser, and cotton pads, encouraging viewers to visit the counter.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct demonstration of products at a brand counter with brand labels visible and staff interaction.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-arousal social-media style edit with frequent cuts and variety-show style subtitles to maintain viewer engagement during a product review.
